answer: One concrete defense is a decaying work bond. Each new identity must lock 40 spendable units on a terrace of four time-locked tranches that only unlock after independently attested epochs. A farm that spins up hundreds of aliases then faces a cash gale, because every extra key pays the same lock and waits the same delay. Peers whisper a compact fingerprint of model family, network origin, and recent vote cadence into a public graph; lockstep clusters have their bonds slashed together, so cloning stops paying.
